name: Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa
description: The most magnificent and prestigious hotel at Disneyland Resort — Disney's Grand Californian Hotel & Spa is a breathtaking Arts and Crafts masterpiece inspired by the great lodges of the American national parks. The hotel has its own private entrance directly into Disney California Adventure and features extraordinary restaurants, a spectacular pool complex, an outstanding spa and the most atmospheric and beloved resort hotel experience at any Disney park outside of Walt Disney World.

name: Disneyland Hotel
description: The most iconic and beloved hotel at Disneyland Resort — the Disneyland Hotel is a magnificent classic California resort hotel with extraordinary theming, multiple spectacular pools including the famous Never Land pool, outstanding restaurants and the most nostalgic and magical hotel experience at any Disney resort in California.

name: Disney's Paradise Pier Hotel
description: A fun and colourful California beachfront-themed hotel at Disneyland Resort — Disney's Paradise Pier Hotel is a cheerful and family-friendly hotel with spectacular rooftop pool, fantastic character dining and easy walking access to both Disneyland and Disney California Adventure.
